description: Render an SVG to a raster image (PNG/JPEG/WebP/AVIF/TIFF). The inverse of vectorize, and the way to see what an SVG actually draws — an agent that has produced or received SVG can turn it into pixels it is able to inspect.

background.description: Paint onto this colour, e.g. "#ffffff". SVGs render on transparent by default.

output.description: Destination path; its extension chooses the encoder (default .png)

width.description: Render width in pixels; height follows the aspect ratio

name: rasterize
